import requests
import json
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import Descriptors, Lipinski

cid = 13471
url = f"https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/cid/{cid}/property/HBondDonorCount,HBondAcceptorCount,IUPACName,CanonicalSMILES,MolecularFormula/JSON"

response = requests.get(url)
data = response.json()
print("PubChem API response:")
print(json.dumps(data, indent=2))

props = data['PropertyTable']['Properties'][0]
smiles = props['CanonicalSMILES']
mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiles)

rdkit_hbd_lipinski = Lipinski.NumHDonors(mol)
rdkit_hbd_descriptors = Descriptors.NumHDonors(mol)

print(f"\nPubChem HBondDonorCount: {props.get('HBondDonorCount')}")
print(f"RDKit Lipinski NumHDonors: {rdkit_hbd_lipinski}")
print(f"RDKit Descriptors NumHDonors: {rdkit_hbd_descriptors}")
print(f"Compound Name: {props.get('IUPACName')}")
print(f"SMILES: {smiles}")
